ITEM_ENHANCED: Boss weapon: two bonus attributes added
ITEM_BOSS_BONUS_EXPLAIN: Boss-enhanced: your first copy of this weapon from a boss added two bonus attributes. Later boss copies count as normal copies. Bonus attributes reset at Prestige; merge levels stay.
ITEM_BOSS_BONUS_HINT: The first copy of this weapon you get from a boss adds two bonus attributes (once per run).
REROLL_ATTRIBUTE_CONFIRM: Spend %s gems to reroll %s? The new roll replaces this attribute, even if weaker. Your other attributes stay as they are.
